purpose: Derive the twelfth C2 long-tail promotion queue into source-specific deep-read tasks so each engineered-cell-therapy, organoid/organ-chip, synthetic-biology, radiation/nuclear, sterilization/disinfection, bloodborne-exposure, urogenital, allergic/atopic, dry-eye, auditory-processing, dysarthria or apraxia-of-speech domain-source pair can later be checked for exact claim use, endpoints, population/setting, uncertainty, transfer boundary, downgrade triggers and model position before any reviewed artifact or model admission.

scope.selectionRule: Derive one queued source-specific extraction task for every candidate source attached to every C2-LT-B12 promotion row.
currentLimitations: This queue derives deep-read tasks; it does not contain completed local review or independent fresh review.
A queued task is not evidence that the cited source supports the domain claim seed.

Candidate URLs require source-context reading and may still need manual access if a PubMed abstract, PMC article, official program page, WHO guidance, OSHA standard, NCBI Bookshelf chapter, ASHA portal, NIH public-health page or scientific review blocks automated checks.
No task may be promoted into reviewed Source Cards, variables, endpoints, downgrade checks or calibrated models until exact source-context fields and fresh review are complete.
